beaches.name: Kato Lefkos (northern beaches)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is established on the beaches north of the last textile beach. A naturist directory carries reports from 2011 to 2018 describing nearly all-nude use, and a 2018 report mentions a sign indicating the nudist beach on entering Lefkos. No newer report is documented.

beaches.name: Diakoftis
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the twin beach across the dune at Diakoftis. A naturist directory carries a 2016 report describing all-nude use with rental umbrellas next to the clothed beach and a 2018 report of nude use at quieter coves nearby; no designation or signage is documented.
